breadcrumbs.name: NFC Anti-metal Stickers — On-metal NFC Tags For Asset Tracking & Equipment Labeling

summary: Standard NFC stickers fail completely when applied to metal surfaces — the metal plane shorts out the antenna and the tag produces zero read distance. NFC anti-metal stickers integrate a ferrite or foam spacer layer that isolates the antenna from the metal substrate, restoring full read range. Available in rigid hard-tag and thin flexible formats for IT asset tracking, manufacturing equipment labeling, tool tracking and metal product authentication.
Use these short answers to decide whether this page matches the project before moving into the detail.
Ferrite absorber sheet (standard) or closed-cell foam spacer (flexible)
